title: Quenched Ukrainian Potato Hash
description: A charred, crunchy potato hash with ground cardamom and smoked paprika, egg‑free and perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Wash and dice the potatoes into 2 cm cubes; pat them dry with a towel to remove excess moisture.
Heat the olive oil in a large non‑stick skillet over medium‑high heat until shimmering.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and spread them out in a single layer, letting them sear without stirring for 3 minutes.
Turn the potatoes to brown on all sides, then add the sliced onion, minced garlic, cardamom, smoked paprika, pepper, and salt.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are golden and the onions are translucent, about 10 minutes.
Fold in the chopped dill, parsley, and lemon juice, stirring gently to combine the flavors.
If using vegan sour cream, drizzle it over the hash and give a final gentle stir to create a smoky crust.
Serve hot with a side of fresh rye bread for a hearty hangover cure.
